name: Mae
source: Mae is a non-human girl who has come to Earth from a world unknown to the human race. Mae lives in the human world with her mother, Queen Misa, who rules their home planet. Mae, however, is the princess of that planet and possesses healing abilities. Her only wish is to return home to save her race from extinction, yet, she also finds herself growing fond of Ryo. Mae’s true form is a mythical white fox. She takes on the appearance of a human by choice. Mae is closed off, and difficult to get to open up. She isn’t fond of getting attached to people, yet when she does care for someone, she is very protective of them. She speaks intelligently and with composure.
